rule: No dataset or model enters the translation pipeline, a training run, or a bundled corpus without a row here. pending_verification = do not use yet (verify release + checksum first). excluded = never bundle, never train. read_only = owner assets, touch only on explicit instruction. Checksums are null until the exact bytes are fetched and hashed — a null checksum with pending status is honest; a filled checksum without bytes is not.

entries.name: GRETIL Sanskrit editions (source texts)
entries.release: per-edition; the edition label is recorded on every claim page
entries.attribution: edition named on the claim page; GRETIL materials carry CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where stated (e.g. the Ghaṭakarpara Parlier edition)
entries.notes: Non-commercial: quoting with attribution is how the site already uses these texts; no training, no redistribution of the files. Per-edition licences vary — claim pages name the edition, never a licence we have not verified.

entries.name: Mitrasaṃgraha — CC BY-SA slice
entries.release: 372,791 Sanskrit–English pairs, CC BY-SA 4.0 (as reported by the 2026-11-11 ecosystem audit; locate the exact dataset revision and verify the card before use)
entries.notes: Candidate eval/training corpus. Before any run: fetch the exact revision, sha256 it, record the card URL, then flip to registered. Audit notes compound interpretation and philosophical terminology as known model weaknesses — relevant to our domain.

entries.name: Mitrasaṃgraha — restricted extra slice
entries.notes: ND forbids derivatives: no bundling with the BY-SA slice, no fine-tuning, no redistribution. Quote for reference only. Never enters a corpus file.

entries.name: MITRA-MT (WMT 2026, classical Asian languages)
entries.release: open-weight 9B; weights licence to be read from the release page before any use
entries.notes: Benchmark candidate only (blind eval set). Domain is Buddhist literature — success there does not establish Trika accuracy. infer flips to true after licence + weights are verified.

entries.name: Dharmamitra MITRA lexicon
entries.release: repo revision to pin before use
entries.notes: translation-work already holds a provenance-recorded read-only subset (tools/mitra_grounds.py, 219 Trika headwords). Corpus frequency is evidence, never a vote for philosophical meaning.

entries.name: Process-Sanskrit linguistic database
entries.release: downloadable DB carries non-commercial terms independent of the Python package (audit-reported)
entries.notes: Second-opinion morphology alongside Vidyut. Read the DB licence before download; package licence may differ.

entries.name: Sanskrit Travelogue (LREC 2026)
entries.release: 12,394 texts / 73.1M tokens; published resources described as non-commercial (audit-reported)
entries.notes: Research/search infrastructure candidate only after licence check.

entries.name: Deitybody Mātṛkā curriculum + cards
entries.attribution: owner content; provenance sha256 recorded in data/practice/*.json source blocks
entries.notes: Owner's own material. Assembly rule shown verbatim wherever it renders: modern apparatus, never doctrine.

entries.name: Sanskrit Bruno Wheels (MIT)
entries.attribution: MIT, © 2026 Sanskrit Bruno Wheels project contributors
entries.notes: Curated teaching tier; byte-identical upstream per ATTRIBUTION.md.

entries.name: Kaggle chant gold (kashmir-chant-cards, vagdhenu-chant-gpu)
entries.notes: MASTERPLAN3 guardrail: read-only forever without explicit owner instruction. Never modified, never a training input, never a benchmark target unless the owner says so.
